positions.title: Principal Computer Scientist /Technical Director
positions.description:
Senior technical contributor of a small development team at a startup company building anti-piracy software, intended primarily for the computer game publishing market. 
• Designed most of the key features in the software product set, including forensic watermarking, application and kernel debugger detection, anti-debugger-detector detection, inter-entity heartbeats, run from memory, function wedge detection, and other anti-tampering and anti-monitoring features.
• Implemented many of these, as well as several tools for project building and debugging.
• Contributed to patent filings as a technical reviewer and as an author of provisional filings.
• Interviewed potential developers, mentored other team members, etc.
• Provided technical pre-sales support and other technical representation as needed.

positions.title: Senior Engineer
positions.description:
Adapted an existing printer-oriented web-based network management software application into a more general-purpose application suitable for monitoring and configuring Force's line of embedded computer platforms.
• Implemented an SNMP agent extension on Win2000 to take advantage of additional sensors and Operator Control Panel capabilities in Force’s packet switching backplane (PICMG) systems.
• Contributed to an object-oriented design for a SNMP agent to be used in all future Force server systems with different hardware components, operating systems, high availability features, etc.

positions.title: Principal Software Engineer
positions.description:
Senior technical contributor to a web-based network printing management application for remotely configuring and managing printers and printing systems via SNMP.
• Designed/implemented the proof of concept demo in perl
• Co-designed the hierarchy and organization of the major system objects
• Designed and implemented the persistent object cache, the WinSNMP interface component, and the NT system service structure
• Mentored other team members in C++ and the Win32 API
• Defined the product concept and product requirements, participated in the interview and hiring process, and made recommendations for software and hardware acquisition

positions.title: Principal Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Project leader for a set of Windows utilities/components that supported Digital’s PrintServer printers on Windows.  The software was included with Win95, and NT 3.1/3.5.
• Designed and implemented the traffic and billing file parser for a Cable TV ad insertion system
• Lead developer on the Fax Network Gateway, a fax-to-email service
• Technical contributor in an internal contracting organization
